title: Discount codes at checkout
head: b81d4e7
summary: Shoppers can enter a discount code in the cart. The shop checks the code against its rules, shows the reduced total before checkout, and charges the card for the discounted amount. Every amount is rounded half-even in one place, so the cart, the order and the charge always agree to the cent.
bullets: New `checkout/discounts.py` holds the discount rules: percent off, fixed amount off, minimum spend.
`Cart.total()` takes the discount, so the cart page and the placed order use the same sum.
The charge sent to the payments provider uses the discounted total, rounded half-even.
Partial refunds give back a fair share of the discount instead of the full line price.
Codes live in the existing database; an admin creates them in the back office.

network.caption: Solid lines are calls the shop makes; the dashed line is the card form the provider serves straight into the shopper's browser.

sequence.caption: One checkout with a discount code. Steps 4 to 6 happen before the card is charged.

messages.label: save the order with its discount

decisions.why: The cart, the order and the charge each rounded on their own and could differ by a cent; one function makes them agree.
Keeps a single sum for the cart page and the order instead of a second total that can drift.
Cart, order and refunds all need them; a module of its own avoids three copies.

decisions.decision: Refunds reverse a share of the discount
decisions.why: Refunding the full line price after a discount would pay back more than the shopper paid.

cards.title: Checks on every code
bullets: code exists and has not expired

cards.title: Tested
bullets: unit tests for each rule and for rounding
browser: apply, remove and expired code

changes.change: `Cart.total()` takes an optional discount and rounds half-even.
Charges the discounted total; rounding is passed explicitly.

limits: Only one code per order; stacking codes is out of scope.
Codes are created by an admin only; there is no bulk import.
Receipts emailed before this change keep their old totals.
Browser check covered desktop Chrome only.
